vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.92

The TickerDB skill bundle provides a legitimate integration for a financial market data service. It includes well-documented instructions for an AI agent to handle authentication via email/OTP, manage a server-side watchlist, and perform market analysis using categorical data bands. The use of OpenClaw's cron system for automated reporting and the request for an API key are consistent with the stated purpose of providing financial context to agents, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection (SKILL.md).

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are coherent with a simple market-data API integration and do not request unrelated credentials or install code on the host.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (pre-computed market data) align with requested artifacts: a single API key (TICKERDB_KEY) and calls to api.tickerdb.com. There are no unrelated env vars, binaries, or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to authenticate users (email + one-time code), call the TickerDB API endpoints (api.tickerdb.com/v1), validate tickers, and offer to set up a daily report. It does not ask the agent to read files, other env vars, or transmit data to unexpected endpoints. It does instruct storing the returned API key into the platform credential store (with user confirmation), which is expected for API-based skills.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present (instruction-only skill), so nothing is written to disk or downloaded during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single environment variable (TICKERDB_KEY) is declared as required and used for Bearer auth. This is proportional for an API integration and there are no unrelated secret-like env vars.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. The SKILL.md indicates the agent may persist the API key to the platform credential store after explicit confirmation, which is normal; the skill does not request elevated or cross-skill privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only connector to tickerdb.com and asks only for an API key. Before installing, confirm you trust https://tickerdb.com, and be aware the agent will send the email/OTP to that domain and can persist the returned API key in the platform credential store if you agree. If you are uncomfortable storing long-lived API keys on the platform, decline the save prompt and provide a key only for the session.
